headline: Cisco patches a maximum-severity ISE flaw under active attack
summary: Two outlets report Cisco patching a maximum-severity Identity Services Engine vulnerability that attackers are already exploiting. One outlet identifies it as an authentication bypass and places it days after another Cisco zero-day.
